title: Keep changes within the declared task scope
scope: All code-changing pull requests with a declared task or issue goal; mechanically generated or necessarily coupled supporting changes remain in scope.
applies_when: A coherent changed file or hunk can be compared with the linked task goal, scope, acceptance criteria, and explicit exclusions.
violation: The change introduces behavior, refactoring, a dependency, tooling, or cleanup that is not required by the declared outcome and can be removed without preventing that outcome.
non_violation: Supporting tests, documentation, generated metadata, and prerequisite edits are not violations when the declared outcome requires them; breadth across several files alone is not a violation.
evidence: Cite the declared scope or exclusion, the affected location, and why the changed responsibility is causally independent of the requested outcome.
